name: mathlib_benchmark_v09_2048
description: A benchmark derived from the Lean mathlib corpus for evaluating models that generate formal proofs or proof sketches within a 2048-token context. It measures a model's ability to produce syntactically valid and checkable Lean proofs across a broad set of mathematical theorems and lemmas. Tasks emphasize automated proof generation, premise selection and producing proofs that pass automated proof checking.
reputation: Used in formal-methods and theorem-proving research as a standard benchmark for automatic proof generation and autoformalization tasks.
